# Todo CRUD Spec

Status: accepted

## Scope
- Create, list, update and delete todo items.
- Each todo has an id, a title and a done flag.
- Storage is in memory; restarting the server clears data.

## API
- GET /todos
- POST /todos (body: {"title": string})
- PUT /todos/:id (body: {"title"?: string, "done"?: boolean})
- DELETE /todos/:id

## Non-goals
- Authentication
- Persistent storage
- Pagination

## Acceptance
- Unknown ids return 404.
- Invalid JSON bodies return 400.

# Notes Module Spec

Status: accepted

## Requirements
- Language: Python 3 standard library only.
- Module: notes.py
- Storage: in-memory dict keyed by integer id, starting at 1.
- add_note(title) stores a note and returns its id.
- list_notes() returns a list of (id, title) tuples ordered by id.
- update_note(id, title) changes the title of an existing note.
- delete_note(id) removes an existing note.
- update_note and delete_note raise KeyError for an unknown id.
- Tests: test_notes.py using unittest.

## Out of scope
- Persistence to disk
- Command line interface
- Third-party packages
